The laboratory specialises in accelerated materials development, micro-robotics and stealth technologies. Indian Nationals are invited for walk-in-interview on 06.10.2026 @ 09:30 hrs for the position of One (01) Junior Research Fellow (JRF) to work on project in the area of Development of Smart Materials based robotic application including shape memory alloy and piezoelectric Materials. S. No. Subject Qualification Post / Nos. 01. Mechanical Engineering Essential Qualification: B.E/B.Tech. in Mechanical/Mechatronics Engineering with First Class with a valid GATE score (OR) M.E./M.Tech. with First class in MechanicalMechatronics / Robotics & Automation/Machine Design/Solid Mechanics and B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical/Mechatronics Engineering with First class. Desirable criteria: Working knowledge of finite element packages, CAD, 3D Printing, Composite Materials, basic electronics and instrumentation JRF / 01 No. General Conditions: 1. Late comers will not be allowed. 2. Duly filled in application form with supporting documents in PDF format shall be submitted online on email ID: hrd.dysl-sm@gov.in (below 10MB). 3. verified news lead|advertisement mpysa 2.title: ADVERTISEMENT MPYSA 2026
verified news lead|advertisement mpysa 2.raw_text: DEPARTMENT OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY AND WASTE MANAGEMENTGovernment of Goa“MANOHAR PARRIKAR YUVA SCIENTIST AWARD 2026”Late Shri Manohar Parrikar, former Chief Minister of Goa and Defence Minister of India,believed that the country, particularly its youth, should pursue excellence in Science andTechnology. As a reminder of this ideal, the State of Goa celebrates his birth anniversary,13th December, as “Manohar Parrikar Vidnyan Mahotsav”, featuring lectures and exhibitsby eminent scientists and technologists.During the Mahotsav in 2022, Dr. Pramod Sawant, Hon’ble Chief Minister of Goa,announced the institution of the annual “Manohar Parrikar Yuva Scientist Award” torecognize a young scientist with proven excellence and the promise of futurecontributions. The Award carries a cash prize of ₹ 5,00,000/- and a citation. Now in itsFourth year, the Award will be presented on 13th December 2026 during the Mahotsav.The Department invites applications from Indian scientists/technologists below 35 yearsof age as on 31st December 2025. Applications will be evaluated by an Expert Committeeheaded by Dr. Raghunath Anant Mashelkar, Former Director General, Council of Scientificand Industrial Research (CSIR) and Former Secretary, Department of Scientific andIndustrial Research (DSIR), Government of India . Shortlisted candidates will be invitedfor a presentation before the Committee.EVALUATION CRITERIACandidates shall be judged on:1. Impact of work carried out so far, as reflected through research publications inhigh-impact journals, patents and other measures.2. A viable future action plan, including further research and/or application ofresearch for the benefit of India.The decision of the Expert Committee shall be final. Only one candidate shall beselected each year.APPLICATION SHOULD INCLUDEa. Name of candidate;b. Address, email and contact details;c. Present Institute/University/Organization;d. Educational qualifications, latest first, with grade/percentage whereverapplicable;e. Research institutions/laboratories where worked, latest first;f. Proof of age;g. Account of research carried out so far, including doctoral thesis, highlightingimpact/applications (maximum 500 words);h. Future action plan and roadmap highlighting scientific, technological andsocial relevance to India (maximum 500 words);i. Letter of support from an institution/organization for the proposed work;j. Two letters of recommendation from eminent scientists/academicians familiarwith the applicant’s work
